image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a vintage comic book cover. The cover features stylized, somewhat grotesque character illustrations in pink and black tones against a red background. There is prominent, bold typography at the top which appears to be non-English or stylized gibberish. The physical object shows signs of wear, including creases and slight bending.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The title text consists of nonsensical, malformed characters that mimic the shape of letters but do not form readable words, a common AI generation artifact.

artifact_observations.location: Character hands and held objects (left side)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The anatomy of the hands is distorted, and the objects being held merge indistinctly with the fingers, lacking clear structural boundaries.
There is slight bleeding and softness at the edges of the characters against the red background, and the background texture lacks the consistent halftone pattern expected in printed comics.
